beliefs: f removes the first character only when the input starts with an uppercase letter followed by a lowercase letter [E1, E2]
Inputs starting with an uppercase letter followed by another uppercase letter, a digit, punctuation, or space are returned unchanged [E2]
Inputs starting with lowercase, digit, space, or empty are returned unchanged [E1]
A single uppercase letter is returned unchanged [E2]
notes: E2 shows stripping happens only when the first char is uppercase AND the second char is lowercase (e.g. 'Hello'->'ello', 'Hello!'->'ello!'), but not for 'A','AB','A1','A!','A ','HELLO'. Updated rule to require s[0].isupper() and s[1].islower().
